scope.statement: مَفْعَل (place/time noun) and the مُـ participle are letter-identical whenever the radicals stand literally after the initial مـ; the discriminator is the WRITTEN vowel on THAT initial مـ (damma supports the participle, fatha supports the place-noun), never the penult vowel, which only ever decides voice WITHIN the participle reading -> missing (initial_mim_mark_not_in_surface) or neither-damma-nor-fatha (initial_mim_vowel_unlicensed) written evidence abstains rather than silently dropping the co-surviving mafal_place template (repair of the recorded 2026-08-03 false positives)

in_place_repairs: 2026-08-03: the mafal_place/mu_participle collision (der-r9) was being decided from the penult vowel alone, which silently dropped the co-surviving mafal_place template on every sound/literal triliteral root and produced false positives (مجلس, منزل falsely active_participle; مكتب falsely passive_participle). The consumer now requires the WRITTEN initial-مـ vowel before any resolution of the collision; this is a consumer behaviour change with no template/shape edit in this pack.

و.basis: the hollow form-I agent participle carries a hamza seat in place of the medial weak radical (committed fixtures der-trn-01/02); the uncontracted medial radical is NOT a form-I agent participle

ي.basis: same seat behaviour for a medial yāʾ (committed fixture der-trn-02)

و.basis: derived-form مُـ participles retain the medial weak radical in writing; the active/passive split is carried by the verified penult mark, not by the radical (committed fixture der-trn-03)

ي.basis: same retention for a medial yāʾ

weak_realizations.licensing_note: DELIBERATELY MINIMAL. Only realizations this increment holds committed fixture evidence for are licensed; every other weak realization abstains.
